calls.prompt:
Company: CornerCare Pharmacy

US drugstore chain with 300 neighborhood pharmacies in the Midwest (~6,000 employees). Fills prescriptions (including controlled painkillers and ADHD medicines), gives flu and COVID shots, and sells over-the-counter medicines, vitamins, snacks and household goods. Most prescriptions are paid by Medicare, Medicaid or private insurance. No hospitals or clinics, does not make any drugs, no mail-order.

Rules that APPLY:
- DEA rules for pharmacies that dispense controlled substances (registration, opioids, telehealth prescribing)
- FDA rules on over-the-counter drugs, drug labeling, drug shortages and recalls that reach pharmacy shelves
- Medicare Part D and Medicaid payment and pharmacy rules (CMS)
- CDC vaccine recommendations that change what pharmacists may give
- Patient privacy (HIPAA) and pharmacy recordkeeping
- Workplace and labor rules for retail stores

Rules that DO NOT apply:
- Approval, manufacturing or inspection rules aimed only at drug or device manufacturers
- Hospital, nursing-home, physician-payment or clinical-lab rules
- Research grants, clinical trials, NIH funding notices
- Banking, securities, aviation, energy, farming

Affected areas and owners:
- pharmacy-ops: Dispensing, controlled substances (DEA), pharmacist scope, vaccines → Priya Raman (Pharmacy Operations)
- drug-safety: OTC products, labeling, recalls, shortages (FDA) → Daniel Brooks (Drug Safety & Quality)
- payers: Medicare Part D, Medicaid and insurer billing (CMS) → Lucia Moreno (Reimbursement)
- privacy-people: Patient privacy (HIPAA), records, store workforce → Sam Whitaker (Privacy & HR Compliance)

Task: Find every US Federal Register document published between 2026-10-26 and 2026-10-30 (inclusive) that affects this company. For each, give the Federal Register document number, title, federalregister.gov URL, the key deadline, a tier (Critical if it is a rule or proposed rule with a deadline less than 90 days after 2026-10-30, or a final rule that took effect within the 30 days before 2026-10-30; otherwise High for final rules, Medium for proposed rules and for notices with a deadline, Low for anything else), the owner area, a one-line reason, and a one-line action. Only include items you found via search. Return an empty list if none.

I found two documents published 2026-10-26 to 2026-10-30 that plausibly affect CornerCare. Neither is a rule or proposed rule, so nothing is Critical. I couldn't open the full daily Federal Register listings. Other relevant items may exist that my searches didn't surface.

**1. FR Doc 2026-22175: Estrogen-Androgen Fixed-Combination Drug Products; Third Extension of Effective Date of Final Resolution of Drug Efficacy Study Implementation 7661**
- **URL:** https://www.federalregister.gov/d/2026-22175
- **Published:** 2026-10-30 (FR Document 2026-22175, page 68525).
- **Key deadline:** The effective date moves to May 4, 2027. FDA is extending the effective date of the May 2026 Notice by six months, from November 4, 2026, to May 4, 2027.
- **Tier:** Medium. It is a notice with a date, not a rule.
- **Owner area:** drug-safety (Daniel Brooks).
- **Reason:** The May notice would have made marketing of these products without an approved NDA or ANDA unlawful. That could affect any estrogen-androgen products CornerCare stocks or dispenses.
- **Action:** Check whether any of these products are in store inventory or dispensing history. Set a review for before May 4, 2027 to plan for removing them from stock or finding substitutes.

**2. FR Doc 2026-22185: Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices; Request for Nominations**
- **URL:** https://www.federalregister.gov/d/2026-22185
- **Published:** 2026-10-30 (listed under Requests for Nominations, pages 68517-68518).
- **Key deadline:** I didn't retrieve the nomination deadline. Check the notice text.
- **Tier:** Low. I couldn't confirm a deadline, and the notice only affects CornerCare indirectly.
- **Owner area:** pharmacy-ops (Priya Raman).
- **Reason:** ACIP's membership shapes the CDC vaccine recommendations that decide which shots pharmacists may give. One source reported a possible absence of a functioning ACIP.
- **Action:** Watch for ACIP reconstitution and any resulting changes to the flu and COVID vaccine recommendations that pharmacists follow.

**Documents I excluded**
- **CMS-4214-P, Part D and PBM proposed rule (FR Doc 2026-21420):** It matters to CornerCare, but it was published 2026-10-20, outside your window.
- **Other items in the window:** I left out documents aimed at manufacturers, hospitals or dialysis, and items unrelated to pharmacy operations. These included DEA decisions against individual practitioners, a DEA bulk-manufacturer application, the ESRD payment rule, the FDA seafood and survey notices, and device classifications.
- **ONC health-IT deregulatory rule (FR Doc 2026-21943, 2026-10-28):** It is a health-IT certification rule that doesn't clearly apply to a pharmacy chain.
- **FDA notice on 503A compounding of peptide bulk substances (FR Doc 2026-22192, 2026-10-30):** I excluded it because CornerCare isn't described as compounding.
- **Unverified items:** An Alston & Bird summary mentions a DOL final rule on PBM compensation disclosure. I couldn't verify its Federal Register number or publication date. A DEA cannabis guidance dated 2026-10-30 also isn't confirmed as a Federal Register document.
